BUILDING WITH FAMILY

Growing Alma & Jaime Jewelry

I launched the online store for our family jewelry business, Alma & Jaime Jewelry ↗, based in Atlanta and established in 2001. Now I’m working on what comes next. Maybe bringing it to Seattle? There’s still a lot to figure out, but I’m excited to see where we can take it.

GIVING BACK

Tech for the community

I’m volunteering as a Software Developer with Seattle Digital Commons ↗. I’m looking forward to growing with the team and making civic technology an ongoing part of my life.
